title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Thu Nov 26)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Thu, Nov 26

Wednesday night's availability reports are in. Michigan's 5-star sophomore QB is questionable for Ohio State, LSU's top two wideouts are question marks, and so is Auburn's QB for the Iron Bowl 🧵👇

❓ BRYCE UNDERWOOD | Michigan | SO, 5⭐ | #25 QB

Questionable on Michigan's first report for Ohio State.

Andrew Marsh | SO, 4⭐ | #18 WR is questionable for the second week in a row. JJ Buchanan | SO, 3⭐ | #59 WR is out.

(via Michigan Wolverines On SI)

❓ WINSTON WATKINS | LSU | SO, 4⭐ | #14 WR

Questionable for Arkansas, as is Jackson Harris | SR | #62 WR (via Roundtable Sports).

👀 Messiah Mickens | Virginia Tech | FR, 4⭐ | #64 RB is the No. 2 back if Marcellous Hawkins (questionable) sits (via SB Nation).

❓ BYRUM BROWN | Auburn | SR, 3⭐ | #78 QB

Questionable on the first Iron Bowl report. His words: "I feel phenomenal" (via Montgomery Advertiser).

❓ Parker Livingstone | Oklahoma | JR, 4⭐ | #125 WR: questionable (via Sooners On SI).

Who worries you? 👇
